idea-plugin.name: Eclipse Launch Configs
idea-plugin.description:
Uses Eclipse launch configurations (.launch files) as live run configurations, so a team can share them between Eclipse and IntelliJ IDEA.

  • JUnit and Java Application launch files in the project folders appear as Eclipse Launch run configurations, grouped by Eclipse project, ready to run and debug
  • Changes in IntelliJ IDEA are written back to the .launch file: only the changed attributes are touched, unknown attributes, order and formatting stay as Eclipse wrote them
  • Changes to the file (VCS update, Eclipse, editor) show up immediately
  • Eclipse variables like ${workspace_loc}, ${project_loc}, ${env_var:…} and user defined workspace variables are resolved at launch
  • Eclipse projects are mapped to the IDEA modules by folder, including Gradle source set modules
  • Optionally, Eclipse output folders such as bin/main are replaced by the IDEA module output

action.description: Read all Eclipse .launch files of the project again
